item.title: How to use ngSwitch in Angular
item.description: NgSwitch in Angular provides clean conditional rendering for multiple mutually exclusive conditions, offering better performance than multiple ngIf statements. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented ngSwitch in countless Angular components for dynamic content switching. From my expertise, the most effective approach is using ngSwitch with clear case values and default fallback. This method provides efficient multi-condition rendering with better readability and performance.
